title: Planning Commitment of LLM under Partial Observability
abstract: arXiv:2610.21108v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based planning agents commit to plans of different lengths before interacting with a partially observable environment. Some aggressively commit to a long plan based on assumptions about unobserved states, while others conservatively plan only over what they have observed. Both behaviors emerge implicitly in pre-trained models, whether the LLM outputs a plan directly or generates a PDDL formulation for a classical solver. Aggressive commitment risks costly failures, while conservative commitment risks excessive LLM calls. This choice pits safety against efficiency, a trade-off that has been neither characterized systematically nor made controllable. We investigate aggressive and conservative LLM planners and formalizers on two partially observable domains, where priors are provided as either explicit statistics or common-sense knowledge. Across three LLMs, both strategies reach similar accuracy. Conservative methods achieve fewer fail

translated_title: 部分可观测环境下大语言模型的规划承诺
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的规划智能体在与部分可观测环境交互之前，会承诺执行不同长度的计划。一些智能体基于对未观测状态的假设，激进地承诺执行长计划；而另一些则保守地仅对已观测到的内容进行规划。无论LLM是直接输出计划，还是为经典求解器生成PDDL形式化描述，这两种行为都会在预训练模型中隐式地出现。激进的承诺面临代价高昂的失败风险，而保守的承诺则面临LLM调用过多的风险。这种选择使安全性与效率形成对立，而这一权衡此前既未被系统地刻画，也未实现可控。我们在两个部分可观测领域上研究了激进与保守的LLM规划器和形式化器，其中先验知识以显式统计或常识知识的形式提供。在三个LLM上，两种策略均达到了相似的准确率。保守方法带来更少的失败……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次系统刻画了部分可观测环境下LLM规划智能体“激进承诺”与“保守承诺”之间的安全性与效率权衡，并研究了使其可控的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically characterizes the safety-efficiency trade-off between aggressive and conservative plan commitment in LLM-based planning agents under partial observability, and investigates making this trade-off controllable.
